name: loop-demonstration
description: A synthetic fixture for demonstrating that the decision loop runs end to end on data with a detectable structure in it. Not market data: every price is generated by qip-market-ingestion's tape tests from a fixed rotation, so there is no source, no licence and no question of either. Hourly, 320 periods, so it ends inside the roster's 90-day review window. NWSC jumps +1.5% on period 100 (its five-day claim resolves on tape at period 220); MRDN drifts +0.6% a period over periods 180-239 (its ninety-day claim does not resolve on tape); VNTG and ATFB are noise. Regenerate with `cargo test -p qip-market-ingestion demonstration_tape`, which fails naming the expected file when this one drifts.
